_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); seed and crop protection signals

pit_profile.why: Corteva: 'The company competes with producers of seed germplasm, trait developers, and crop protection products on a global basis.'; the FY2020 10-K's risk factors: 'Climate change and unpredictable seasonal and weather factors could impact Corteva’s sales and earnings.'; no disruption theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining), so the weather and climate wording stays here

classification.quality_note: Corteva: 'The company competes with producers of seed germplasm, trait developers, and crop protection products on a global basis.'; the FY2020 10-K's risk factors: 'Climate change and unpredictable seasonal and weather factors could impact Corteva’s sales and earnings.'; no disruption theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining), so the weather and climate wording stays here. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.02x; +14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.90; conservative 2yr +11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY20-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.0%/yr (FY22 net sales guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.1-yr ex-FY19 median

BULL.desc: EPS +149.0%/yr (FY20-FY21 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +149.0%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY20-FY21: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CTVA (retrospective, 2022-02-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.02x (14.4% downside to Bear $43 / +773.6% upside to Bull $439) | Adj composite 3.12 vs market 1.22: gap +1.90 [UNDERVALUED] | +14% above the EPP floor $44 (18x FY22E $2.44) | Conservative 2-yr case: +11.4% total (+5.7%/yr) | At 20.6x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $66 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Seed organic +12.0% and Crop Protection organic +7.0% in Q4 2021, forward revenues +6.7-8.6% (FY2022 net sales guide $16.7-17.0B (Q4 2021 release) on FY21 $15.655B, no Q1 2022 guide); no theme in the registry covers seed and crop protection (GLP1 is scoped to snacks, beverages and devices, ENERGY_TRANSITION to oil, gas and coal reserves and refining); none has dated evidence.
